name: Hieu Nguyen
blurb: Having worked with 3 growing businesses over the course of 5 years, Hieu has found a passion for becoming the bridge between what a business needs and what a team can build. Give him a vague idea and a whiteboard, and he'll hand you back a plan.

name: Kamil Ahmed
blurb: From at least a couple of years ago to now, Kamil enjoys playing football. His favourite food is pizza but he enjoys a few Pakistani dishes. Kamil believes that honesty and hard work are key things that contribute to success

name: Abhinav Kandel
blurb: Abhinav enjoys building things that work. With a focus on clean code and problem-solving, he brings a hands-on approach to development and is always keen to learn new tools and frameworks along the way.
